caption: A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
relations: The car moves rapidly forward and collides with the brick wall, transferring its kinetic energy to the wall and the car's front structure.
The front end of the car deforms under the impact force, crumpling inward as the car's metal frame compresses and bends.
The car's forward motion stops abruptly as the wall exerts an equal and opposite force, halting the vehicle's momentum.
The wall remains fixed in place, absorbing the impact through localized stress at the contact point without visible movement.
